svg.title: Application wiring replaces the provider plumbing
svg.desc: ClangdMain explicitly creates the tidy module; server and ParseInputs forward the generic module set. The module set is constructed before check mode, so both --check and the LSP server receive it. Check mode installs the module even with tidy disabled, allowing temporary timing configuration.
svg.text: Application wiring replaces the provider plumbing
ClangdMain explicitly creates the tidy module; server and ParseInputs forward the generic module set.
/// The Options provider to use when running clang-tidy. If null, clang-tidy
// When set, provides clang-tidy options for a specific file.
// Used to acquire ASTListeners when parsing files.
// Used to build and manage (C++) modules.
// Check mode needs the module for timing even when tidy is disabled.
// Used to acquire ASTListeners when parsing files.
// Used to build and manage (C++) modules.
The module set is constructed before check mode, so both --check and the LSP server receive it.
Check mode installs the module even with tidy disabled, allowing temporary timing configuration.
Colors follow git diff · unchanged context is gray · arrows map responsibilities, not entire excerpts
